summary: Opened 2026-09-25, nothing run yet. This step builds the Track 2 answer from iteration 4 alone. Four sources that share no data each propose approved drugs: the PrimeKG walk (entry 142), the child's phenotype twin among mouse models (entry 150), a screen-wide PRISM sweep (entry 154) and LINCS signature reversal (entry 153). The step tests whether they agree more often than chance, then filters the agreeing drugs through three checks: mechanism direction, the child's own safety (genome and clinical terms), and a contrary screen result. The rules for every list were fixed before any join.
why: Step 9's E4 and E5+E6 tested drugs drawn from iteration 2's shortlist. A submission built from iteration 4 only cannot borrow that list, so iteration 4 must generate its own candidates and re-run its checks on them.
verdict: Not yet tested. H093 (screen-wide PRISM), H094 (convergence against a permutation null) and H095 (at least one survivor) are filed and proposed.

inherits.what: Step 7's PrimeKG walk ranking, step 9's phenotype twin interventions (E2), PRISM readers and tests (E4), the per-child safety method (E5+E6) and the LINCS signature reversal (E3). The confirmed BUB1B pair comes from Track 1's oracle reply (entry 083).

hands_to.what: The candidate table and survivors for submissions/track2/iteration-4/.
